name: Smoky Ranch Red Potato Salad
sub: Red potatoes · 4 side servings · estimated macros
text:
POTATO PREPARATION
Scrub 1½ lb red potatoes; leave skins on and cut into ¾-inch pieces. Cover with cold water by an inch, salt lightly, bring to a gentle boil, and simmer 10–15 minutes until just fork-tender. Drain well and spread out for 5–10 minutes.

INGREDIENTS
1½ lb red potatoes (prepared above)
½ cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt
1 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp Dijon or yellow mustard
½ tsp smoked paprika
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
1 tsp dried parsley
½ tsp dried dill
2 green onions, sliced
½ cup diced celery
2 strips cooked bacon, crumbled (optional)
Salt and black pepper to taste

METHOD
1. Toss warm potatoes with vinegar; cool.
2. Mix yogurt, mayonnaise, mustard, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, parsley, and dill.
3. Fold in potatoes, green onions, celery, and optional bacon.
4. Refrigerate 2 hours; adjust seasoning before serving.

ESTIMATED MACROS
Without bacon, per ¼ batch: 170 kcal · 6.8 g protein · 30.0 g carbs · 3.0 g fat · 3.5 g fiber.
Without bacon, whole batch: 680 kcal · 27.2 g protein · 120.1 g carbs · 12.2 g fat.
With 2 strips bacon per batch, per ¼ batch: 191 kcal · 8.3 g protein · 30.1 g carbs · 4.7 g fat · 3.5 g fiber.
With bacon, whole batch: 766 kcal · 33.1 g protein · 120.3 g carbs · 18.9 g fat.
Optional extra smoke: mix one drop liquid smoke into dressing, taste, then add another only if needed. Base macros use yellow mustard and exclude liquid smoke.

NUTRITION STATUS
Generic estimates saved from conversation, October 25, 2026; not calculated from saved brand labels. Each recipe makes 4 side servings. A serving is ¼ of the finished batch, not a fixed weight. Brand, bacon size, and optional ingredients affect totals.
Refrigerate leftovers and use within 3–4 days.
